sentences.en: Tell me about an accomplishment you are most proud of.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你最引以为豪的一项成就。

sentences.en: Lindbergh's solo nonstop transatlantic flight was a remarkable accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 林德伯格独自不间断横跨大西洋飞行是一项了不起的成就。

sentences.en: High moral character is not a precondition for great moral accomplishments.
sentences.zh: 高尚的道德品质不是伟大道德成就的前提条件。

senses.zh: 完成，实现 - 技能, (社交上的)才艺 - 成绩；成就；完成的工作
